title: Towel Rack
text: Towel Rack. This towel rack is lightweight and extremely easy to assemble.  I was able to do it without a few seconds.  I like that it holds several towels and fits over the doors in our apartment.  We live in a small apartment so being able to find alternative storage is great! What I do not like about it, however, is that, once installed, we are unable to close our door!  We live in an older building with the old wooden doors.  Once we installed the towel rack, we were unable to close the door all of the way.  Due to this, we have moved it to our bedroom door.  We live in an older apartment with thicker doors.  This may not be the case with every door though.  I also think it is a bit overpriced ($39.99).  I like the OXO brand and have many of their other products so I understand their items can be a bit pricey.  For a towel rack that doesn't allow us to close our door, I would expect it to be a little less expensive.

product_metadata.title: OXO Over-the-Door Towel Rack
features: Spring steel on hook accommodates a variety of door sizes
3 large-capacity towel bars can be arranged in any order
Non-slip bumpers won’t scratch or damage door
Sturdy spine provides rack with stability and structure
Perfect for bath towels, washcloths and more
description: Hang multiple towels at once with the oxo good grips over-the-door towel rack. This rack features three different sized metal bars that can be arranged in any order. The hook is designed to comfortably fit a variety of door sizes and has bumpers so the rack will not scratch or damage your door. The rack’s sturdy spine provides structure and stability for your towels, washcloths and more.
